title: Make the header branding image slightly bigger

requirements.text: Increase the size of the header branding image in the sticky SiteHeader so it is slightly bigger across responsive breakpoints, without causing layout overflow or misalignment in the header.

quotes: Image is to be made slightly bigger

acceptanceCriteria: The logo image rendered in the header (frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx, ) appears noticeably but only slightly larger than before on mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
The header layout remains vertically centered, and the logo does not overlap the brand name text or the desktop navigation/CTA.
No horizontal overflow is introduced at any viewport width (no unexpected x-scroll).
The logo remains crisp and maintains aspect ratio (no stretching).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn UI primitives are read-only).
Keep the existing single-page marketing layout and sticky header behavior intact.
nonGoals: Do not change hero images, section content, navigation structure, or CTA copy.
